    AI Overview
    No, Justin Rose has not won the Masters Tournament. Despite a stellar career that includes a 2013 U.S. Open title and 2016 Olympic gold, the Englishman has come close at Augusta National with multiple runner-up finishes (2015, 2017, 2025) but has not yet secured a green jacket. He finished tied for third in the 2026 Masters. 
    Key Details on Justin Rose at the Masters: 
    • Best Finishes: Runner-up in 2015, 2017 (lost in a playoff to Sergio Garcia), and 2025 (lost in a playoff to Rory McIlroy).
    • 2026 Performance: Finished tied for third place, after leading during the final round
      .
    • Consistency: He is widely recognized for his high level of performance at Augusta, with multiple top-five finishes, yet he has not managed a win.
